{{Quote|Tarnis will use the Planet Prison against Coruscant. He could trap us here forever. Paralyze the Republic by holding us hostage. You're our only hope of stopping that.|General Var Suthra|<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />}}
During the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]], a [[Hero of Tython|young Jedi Knight]]&mdash;the former [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]]&mdash;was sent on a '''mission''' to the Republic [[Capital/Legends|capital]] of [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to investigate a dark presence there. Accompanied by the [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] [[T7-O1]], who had helped the young [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] put a stop to the recent [[Flesh Raider uprising]] on the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], the Knight worked with the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] and the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] to stop the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]] from activating the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]].

After a gang of [[Scoundrel/Legends|thieves]] [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|stole]] the design files for the Planet Prison from a [[Unidentified Republic Military warehouse|military warehouse]] on Coruscant, the Strategic Information Service tracked the thieves back to the criminal organization known as the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]]. The newly-arrived Jedi Knight and T7-O1 were immediately sent to [[Raid on the Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|recover the files]], but [[Doctor/Legends|Doctor]] Eli Tarnis&mdash;the Planet Prison's designer and secretly a [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] who had been undercover as a Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]]&mdash;orchestrated his own [[Kidnapping of Doctor Tarnis|kidnapping]] by his allies in the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate so that he could proceed with his plans.

Chasing the kidnappers to the [[Coruscant Spaceport]], the Padawan [[Kira Carsen]] and the CSF were aided by the Knight in [[Skirmish in Docking Bay 84|retaking the hangar]] where the criminals were holed up and discovered that the kidnappers were actually a decoy. Tarnis had retreated to the [[Justicar territory|territory]] of the paramilitary [[Justicars' Brigade]], but the Jedi unknowingly followed another false lead into [[Black Sun territory|Black Sun Territory]] in a vain attempt to rescue the scientist. After staging a [[Raid on the Black Sun headquarters|successful assault]] on the [[Black Sun Headquarters|syndicate's headquarters]] with the help of an [[Special tactical unit|elite CSF team]], the Knight failed to find Tarnis&mdash;but instead discovered Tarnis' true identity and his plans for the Planet Prison.

As the Republic scrambled to secure their other jeopardized weapon projects from the Empire, Carsen and the Knight [[Mission to Justicar territory|tracked]] Tarnis to the Justicar's Sector, only to find that he had [[Death/Legends|murdered]] the Planet Prison design team and stolen the superweapon after tricking them into bringing it to him. With the help of a [[Jonkan|dying scientist]], the two Jedi traced the Planet Prison's signal to the ruins of the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]], and they confronted the Sith Lord in the depths of the damaged edifice. Tarnis, who revealed his identity as the son of the Sith Lord [[Darth Angral]], battled the pair in a fierce [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|duel]] before [[Hologram/Legends|holograms]] of his [[Parent/Legends|father]] and Angral's apprentices as the Planet Prison inched ever closer to activation. To Angral's fury, the [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|duel]] ended with the death of Tarnis at the hands of the Knight, and the Sith Lord would embark on a [[Desolator crisis|crusade]] of vengeance against the entire Republic in response.

==Prelude==
{{Quote|All I've ever wanted was to protect the Republic. I was stationed here when the Empire attacked Coruscant. Saw the Jedi Temple destroyed. All those Padawans and Masters cut down&hellip; I started these weapon projects in their honor.|Var Suthra|<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />}}
The events on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] had their beginnings in the last [[Standard day/Legends|days]] of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]]. The Empire deceived the Republic with sham [[Alderaan peace conference|peace negotiations]] on the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core World]] of [[Alderaan/Legends|Alderaan]] while they attacked the Republic's [[Capital/Legends|capital]] in what would become known as the [[Sacking of Coruscant]]. After a strike team led by [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lords]] [[Darth Malgus]] and [[Adraas]] destroyed the [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Jedi Temple]] and took down the planet's defense grid, [[Death/Legends|massacring]] a great number of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] in the process, the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] [[Lord/Legends|Lord]] [[Darth Angral]] held the capital hostage with an invasion [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]].<ref name="Deceived">''[[The Old Republic: Deceived]]''</ref> The Empire then forced the Republic into signing the [[Treaty of Coruscant]],<ref name="Timeline 1">{{TORweb|url=holonet/galactic-history|text=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant|int=Timeline 1: Treaty of Coruscant}}</ref> requiring the Republic to withdraw its forces from across [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]] and beginning an uneasy peace known as the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] migrated to their recently rediscovered [[Homeworld/Legends|homeworld]] of [[Tython/Legends|Tython]], where they rebuilt their numbers amidst scattered attacks by the native [[Flesh Raider]]s.<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Attack of the Flesh Raiders|Tython}}</ref>

{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
These attacks would take on a sinister purpose in the [[Standard year/Legends|year]] [[3643 BBY]]<ref name="Time" /> when it was discovered that the [[Nautolan/Legends|Nautolan]] [[Dark Jedi/Legends|Dark Jedi]] [[Bengel Morr]] was manipulating the natives against the Order in an attempt to destroy the Jedi. The former [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] of [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Orgus Din]], Morr had been inside the Temple on Coruscant during Malgus' attack and was presumed dead when his body was not recovered. However, he had actually escaped the attack and subsequently went insane, turning to the [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side of the Force]] and blaming the Jedi for submitting to the Sith.<ref name="The Face of the Enemy">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Face of the Enemy|Tython}}</ref> Morr's Flesh Raider forces began to [[Flesh Raider uprising|attack]] the Jedi in an attempt to destroy them,<ref name="Attack of the Flesh Raiders" /> but Din and his [[Hero of Tython|newest apprentice]] uncovered the Dark Jedi's plans and put a stop to them. For rescuing Din from his former student and defeating Morr<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi" /> with the help of a Jedi [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]] designated [[T7-O1]],<ref name="High-Tech Savages">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|High-Tech Savages|Tython}}</ref> Din's Padawan was elevated to the rank of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Satele Shan]] and sent to Coruscant with T7-O1 and Din.<ref name="Weapon of the Jedi" />
{{Endgame}}

[[File:Eli_Tarnis.png|thumb|right|180px|Doctor "Eli Tarnis"]]
The agents of the Empire were also busy during the [[Time/Legends|decade]] following the Treaty, however. Angral's son [[Tarnis (Sith Lord)|Tarnis]], who was [[Sith training|trained]] in the ways of the dark side by Angral's own apprentice Lord [[Praven]],<ref name="Desert Duel">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Tatooine|Desert Duel|Tatooine}}</ref> entered into an undercover mission on the Republic capital itself. Under the alias "Eli Tarnis," he masqueraded<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" /> as a Republic [[Scientist/Legends|scientist]] and inserted himself into the development team for the [[Planet Prison]] [[Superweapon/Legends|superweapon]],<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> where he gathered information on the Republic's weapon projects.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" /> The Planet Prison was one of many weapons projects started by [[Mon Calamari/Legends|Mon Calamari]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Var Suthra]] in honor of the Jedi killed during the destruction of the Jedi Temple,<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> and by 3643 BBY,<ref name="Time" /> the weapon was in the prototype stage.<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />

==The mission==
===Deception===
{{Quote|Thirty-two hours ago, thieves raided a military storehouse. They stole weapons, supplies and data files for the Planet Prison project.|Agent Galen|<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />}}
Around that time, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] had become concerned about a seemingly dark presence they could sense on the capital, even all the way from Tython in the [[Deep Core/Legends|Deep Core]]. The [[Jedi Council/Legends|Council]] had dispatched Jedi Master [[Bela Kiwiiks]] and her Padawan [[Kira Carsen]] to Coruscant during the war with the Flesh Raiders in order to investigate, and Tarnis sensed that his mission was in jeopardy. Therefore, he approached [[Salarr]], the leader of the [[Black Sun/Legends|Black Sun]] criminal syndicate, and revealed his true identity as a Sith Lord. In exchange for Imperial weapons and technology<ref name="The Rescue" /> acquired through Tarnis's contacts<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" /> in the Imperial-friendly [[Justicars' Brigade]] paramilitary group,<ref name="A Diverting Assignment">{{TORcite|type=general|A Diverting Assignment|Coruscant}}</ref> Black Sun would help the Sith in the elaborate deception he was about to perpetrate.<ref name="The Rescue" />

[[File:Vistis_gun.png|thumb|left|300px|Vistis Garn, one of the many pawns in Tarnis's game]]
At Tarnis's request,<ref name="The Rescue" /> Black Sun sent a team of [[Scoundrel/Legends|thieves]] led by the [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] [[Vistis Garn]]&mdash;who often worked for Black Sun's rival, the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild]]&mdash;to [[Raid on a Republic Military warehouse|raid]] a [[Unidentified Republic Military warehouse|military warehouse]] in order to steal the design files<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> for all of the Republic's superweapon projects.<ref name="Kidnapped" /> The raid was successful, and Garn's team made off with the files and a shipment of advanced weapons and munitions, but the Rodian was caught on a security camera as the group was departing for the Guild-controlled [[Old Galactic Market]].<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> Tarnis planned to take the stolen files with him back to the Empire but also intended to strike a blow against the Republic before leaving.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> [[Agent/Legends|Agent]] [[Galen (SIS)|Galen]] of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]], the Republic's primary intelligence agency, was ordered to head the search for the stolen plans, and his office collaborated with the [[Coruscant Security Force/Legends|Coruscant Security Force]] in their efforts.<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />

Thirty-two [[Standard hour/Legends|hours]] later, General Suthra met with Din, Kiwiiks, Carsen, and Tarnis in [[Conference Room 2-Aurek]] in the [[Senate Building/Legends|Senate Building]] to discuss the status of the security breach, and they were soon joined by Din's former apprentice and T7-O1. Tarnis was irritated that the Jedi disapproved of the Planet Prison weapon&mdash;as it [[Ion cannon/Legends|ionized]] a planet's [[Atmosphere/Legends|atmosphere]], thus [[Blockade/Legends|blockading]] a world and preventing any [[Starship/Legends|ships]] from leaving or arriving, as it was a humane method of warfare that he believed the Jedi should favor. During the discussion, Galen's subordinates had identified Garn as one of the thieves and tracked him to the Old Galactic Market, causing the agent to interrupt the meeting with the news. Leaving Galen to work with the Knight and Carsen on the search, Suthra departed with Kiwiiks and Din in order to meet with [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Dorian Janarus]] aboard the official's personal [[Flagship/Legends|flagship]], the [[Founder (Valor-class)|''Founder'']], above Coruscant.<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />

===Recovery attempts===
{{GameLS|Star Wars: The Old Republic}}
{{Quote|While you were gone, kidnappers grabbed Doctor Tarnis.''"<br />"''This is the most secure building on Coruscant. It's full of guards.''"<br />"''Guards never stood a chance. Whoever the kidnappers are, they knew right where to hit us.|Galen briefs the Knight on the situation|<ref name="Kidnapped" />}}
Tarnis remained behind as the two Masters departed with Suthra, and Galen gave his report to the Knight and Carsen. By that time, the SIS had tracked Garn back to the Old Galactic Market with the aid of the Coruscant Security Force, and the Knight immediately departed for the Guild's territory with T7-O1 while Carsen and Galen worked to distract the gangsters with the CSF's security network. Arriving in the Market, the Jedi and T7-O1 fought their way into the heart of the region and [[Raid on the Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|raided]] the [[Migrant Merchants' Guild warehouse|warehouse]] where Garn was holed up. The Knight made short work of the Rodian's crew and stormed the secure vault into which Garn had retreated, defeating the [[Autoturret/Legends|autoturrets]] the thief had set up. Interrogating Garn, the Jedi learned that Black Sun had hired him and that a copy of the now-decrypted plans had already been sent to the gang.<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />

[[File:CSFBarricade.png|thumb|right|300px|The CSF lay siege to the Black Sun criminals in the spaceport.]]
Following the Knight's departure, Tarnis put the second part of his plan in motion by signaling a Black Sun "kidnapping" team<ref name="The Rescue" /> led by the [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Zeer (criminal)|Zeer]].<ref name="Kidnapped" /> With inside information supplied by the Sith Lord,<ref name="The Rescue" /> the criminals infiltrated the Senate Building and [[Kidnapping of Doctor Tarnis|made off]] with the scientist before [[Senate Security Officer|Senate Security]] detected them.<ref name="Kidnapped" /> As part of their arrangement,<ref name="The Rescue" /> Zeer and his men fled to the nearby [[Coruscant Spaceport]] to serve as a distraction so that Tarnis could escape to [[Black Sun territory|Black Sun Territory]]<ref name="Kidnapped" />&mdash;but the Sith Lord instead chose to head to the [[Justicar territory|Justicars' Sector]] in order to continue his plans.<ref name="The Rescue" /> When the SIS and Senate Security realized what had transpired, Galen dispatched a CSF team under Carsen's leadership to the [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] to retrieve the doctor<ref name="Kidnapped" /> and ordered the Knight to return immediately when the second Jedi contacted the agent to report the raid's outcome.<ref name="Stolen Secrets" />

Allowing Garn to leave in peace in exchange for the information, the Knight recovered the other stolen weapons and left them to be taken into custody by the CSF forces in the area<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> before returning to the Senate Building. There, the Jedi and T7-O1 were briefed on the situation and sent to the spaceport to reinforce Carsen and the CSF, who were in a stalemate with the Black Sun gang. The two Jedi were able to [[Skirmish in Docking Bay 84|break]] the criminals' lines through the Knight's combat prowess and Carsen's use of a borrowed SIS [[Stealth field generator/Legends|stealth field generator]], confronting Zeer and quickly defeating him. Carsen convinced Zeer to tell them where the doctor had been taken by pretending to read his mind and terrifying the criminal, and the two Jedi left the Black Sun members to the CSF as they returned to the Senate Building.<ref name="Kidnapped" />

[[File:SpecialTacticalUnitarrives.png|thumb|left|300px|The special tactical unit arrives to support the Knight.]]
There, they found that Galen's analysts had read through the recovered data files and discovered that they contained information on all of the Republic's superweapon projects. Suthra, having returned from the meeting with the Chancellor, was worried about the safety of the facilities, so Kiwiiks and Din agreed to secure one of the three off-world projects each. Agent Galen also departed to secure the third facility, but before leaving, he told the Knight to contact [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Nidaljo]] of the CSF's [[special tactical unit]] in Black Sun Territory. Galen contacted Nidaljo as he was heading to his ship, and the special tactical unit attempted to set up a perimeter around [[Black Sun Headquarters|Black Sun's headquarters]] for the upcoming mission to rescue Tarnis from the structure. However, the gang had attacked with advanced weapons and [[Armor/Legends|armor]], killing half a dozen of Nidalgo's men and forcing the unit to retreat into an abandoned building. There, the Jedi and T7-O1 found Nidaljo and his men trapped behind a hastily erected barricade, pinned down by heavily armed Black Sun members, and the Knight quickly dispatched the criminals.<ref name="The Rescue" />

===A traitor revealed===
{{Quote|You won't get away with betraying the Republic, Doctor Tarnis.''"<br />"''The name is Lord Tarnis. I've shed that old skin.|Tarnis and the Jedi Knight|<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />}}
The [[Police officer/Legends|police officer]] was ready to give up hope, but the Knight reminded him of his duty and how the fallen members of his [[Squad/Legends|squad]] had given their lives to aid the man trapped inside the enemy headquarters. Inspired by the Jedi, the entire unit rallied to the Knight's call to arms and prepared to launch their [[Raid on the Black Sun headquarters|attack]]. Nidaljo's men targeted the rear entrance of the compound, while the Knight and T7-O1 stormed the front entrance and cut their way through several dozen Black Sun members to reach the central room first&mdash;where the pair were astonished to discover that Tarnis was not present in the building, but was in fact speaking with Salarr, Black Sun's leader, via a [[Hologram/Legends|holotransmission]].<ref name="The Rescue" />

[[File:Tarnis_holo_hood.png|thumb|right|250px|Tarnis betrayed Slarr as soon as he was no longer useful.]]
Listening to Salarr's angry exchange with Tarnis, the Knight learned that the entire affair had been staged&mdash;Tarnis had hired the criminals to steal the files and kidnap him. When the Jedi accused the scientist of [[Treason/Legends|treason]], Tarnis revealed that he was in fact a Sith Lord and ended the transmission after informing Salarr that his services were no longer required. Furious, Salarr turned to confront the Jedi, but Nidaljo's unit burst into the room at that moment and shot the Black Sun member who was sneaking up on the Knight. Together, the CSF and the Jedi fought and defeated Salarr's men, striking down the syndicate's leader and dealing an impairing blow to Black Sun's operations. While Nidaljo's men retreated to a safer location and the Knight returned to the Senate Building,<ref name="The Rescue" /> Tarnis began to put the third stage of his plans in motion. Upon arriving in the Justicars' Sector, he contacted his research team and informed them that the Jedi were planning on shutting down the Planet Prison project. Imploring them to do the right thing for the Republic, he convinced the scientists to bring the prototype to him in the [[Justicars' Tower]]. But when the team arrived, Tarnis turned on them and massacred his subordinates before taking the prototype deep into the ruins of the Jedi Temple.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />

===Race against time===
{{Quote|Running a thermal scan&hellip; whoa, the technician wasn't kidding. Something's really lighting up. Tracking&hellip; Here we go. Sector 167, coordinates 8863&hellip; Oh, you've got to be kidding me. The signal's coming from the ruins of the Jedi Temple.|Kira Carsen|<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />}}
Back in the Senate Building, General Suthra was both furious and horrified that a Sith had infiltrated his people so easily, and when Carsen traced Tarnis's holotransmission to the Justicars' Sector, he immediately dispatched the two Jedi to recover both the prototype and the research team&mdash;whom he also suspected were traitors. But once the two Jedi [[Mission to Justicar territory|fought their way]] to the source of the transmission, they found the bodies of the research team and realized the truth. One scientist, a man named [[Jonkan]], was still alive, and with his last breaths, he managed to tell the Jedi that the Planet Prison required time to charge and how it generated immense amounts of heat while doing so. Using that information, Carsen located the Planet Prison in the Jedi Temple,<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" /> and the two Jedi raced through the industrial sector known as [[The Works/Legends|the Works]] to reach the Temple.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

[[File:Council_Chamber.png|thumb|left|300px|The Planet Prison, set up in the Jedi Temple]]
Fighting through Imperial strike teams<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> searching for lost information amidst the ruins,<ref name="Enemies of the Republic">{{TORcite|type=heroic|Enemies of the Republic|Coruscant}}</ref> the Knight and Carsen finally located Tarnis in the chambers of the Jedi Council. Having set up the machinery of the Planet Prison in the chamber, Tarnis was using the Temple's own power grid to charge the superweapon while he conversed with four holograms. Listening to the conversation, the Knight and Carsen were shocked to discover that the people were [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] Angral and his apprentices, Lords [[Sadic]], [[Nefarid]], and Praven; but they were more astonished to hear Tarnis call Angral "[[Parent/Legends|father]]."<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

Approaching the Sith Lord, the Knight asked Tarnis to surrender peacefully, but the older man was egged on by both his father and Angral's apprentices so that he charged the two Jedi, unleashing a blast of [[Color/Legends|violet]] [[Force lightning/Legends|lightning]]. The three engaged in a fierce [[Duel in the Jedi Temple ruins|duel]] before the holoterminal, and Angral watched in horror and fury as his son was slowly beaten back and finally struck down by the Knight's [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]]. Consumed by anger and grief, the elder Sith Lord declared undying hatred upon his son's killer and promised the Knight that he would exact his revenge even if it meant destroying the entire Republic. After Angral ended the communication, the Knight and Carsen inspected the Planet Prison. They found that it was not yet fully charged, and the two Jedi were able to render it useless and return to the Senate Building safely.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />
{{Endgame}}

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|I will inflict unimaginable suffering on your people. Billions will die because of you. [&hellip;] My son's death will be avenged on the entire Republic&mdash;and you will bow down before I let you die.|Darth Angral|<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />}}
{{Main|Desolator crisis}}
[[File:Angralhead.png|thumb|right|180px|Angral's hatred would consume entire worlds as he sought revenge.]]
While the crisis on Coruscant ended with the deactivation of the Planet Prison, the mission would have far-reaching consequences. True to his world, Angral embarked on a [[Desolator crisis|crusade]] against the Knight, including both the Republic and the Jedi Order in his mad quest for revenge.<ref name="New Intelligence" /> Sending his apprentices and agents to various worlds, he took advantage of his son's information and seized control of the Republic's superweapon projects, combining them into a ship-mounted world-killer weapon<ref name="Uphrades">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Uphrades|the ''Daybreaker''}}</ref> known as the [[Desolator (superweapon)|Desolator]].<ref name="New Intelligence" />

Traveling with T7-O1 and Carsen, who was made the Knight's official Padawan by Grand Master Shan,<ref name="New Intelligence" /> the Jedi [[Mission to Ord Mantell (Desolator crisis)|uncovered]] Angral's plans on the planet [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], and thus battled Angral's apprentices and [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] in order to destroy the stolen superweapons before they could be used against the rest of the [[Galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Uphrades" /> The trio finally faced Angral aboard his flagship, the [[Oppressor (Harrower-class)|''Oppressor'']], above Tython after the Sith Lord [[Devastation of Uphrades|used the Desolator]] against the Republic [[Agriworld/Legends|agriworld]] of [[Uphrades]]. Together, the Knight and Carsen were able to [[Battle of the Oppressor|strike down]] the Sith and end the crisis.<ref name="Fate of the Jedi">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|Fate of the Jedi|the ''Oppressor''}}</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
{{Quote|We already control your secret weapons facilities. All that power is ours, now.|Lord Nefarid introduces the plot line of Act I for the Jedi Knight class|<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />}}
The mission to Coruscant appears in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer role-playing game]] released by [[BioWare]] and [[LucasArts]] in [[2011]].<ref name="TORRelease">{{TORweb|url=info/news/news-article/20111014-1|text=Global Launch for The Old Republic}}</ref> The mission represents the [[in-universe]] events of the Jedi Knight class' Prologue on Coruscant, which is divided into six in-game missions: "The Jedi Envoy," "Stolen Secrets," "Kidnapped!," "The Rescue," "Tracking Down the Traitor," and "Race to the Ruins." As it is the Prologue of the class storyline, the mission sets up the storyline of Act I, and introduces many characters who appear later throughout the game.<ref name="Race to the Ruins" />

[[File:Tarnis_Feathers.png|thumb|left|270px|The duel is the first time that Jedi Knight players face an actual Sith in their class storyline.]]
Kira Carsen is gained as a companion at the end of the planet storyline, and General Suthra sends the player to various planets throughout Act I.<ref name="New Intelligence" /> Bela Kiwiiks will later be [[Mission to Tatooine (Desolator crisis)|encountered]] on the planets [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]],<ref name="The Shock Drum">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Shock Drum|Tatooine}}</ref> Orgus Din [[Mission to Alderaan (Desolator crisis)|on Alderaan]],<ref name="The Death Mark">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Death Mark|Alderaan}}</ref> and Agent Galen [[Mission to Nar Shaddaa (Desolator crisis)|on]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]],<ref name="The Power Guard Project">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Power Guard Project|Nar Shaddaa}}</ref> where they have all been captured or otherwise impaired by the Sith. Angral's apprentices are also introduced in the confrontation with Tarnis, and they serve as the main enemies on Tatooine, Alderaan, and Nar Shaddaa.<ref name="The Shock Drum" /><ref name="The Death Mark" /><ref name="The Power Guard Project" /> The player is first sent to [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]] to recover information on Angral's plans,<ref name="New Intelligence" /> and on [[Taris/Legends|Taris]] the Knight [[Mission to Taris (Desolator crisis)|attempts to rescue]] the scientist Doctor [[Nasan Godera]] from [[Watcher One]] of Imperial Intelligence.<ref name="The Architect of Annihilation">{{TORcite|type=class|Jedi Knight|The Architect of Annihilation|Taris}}</ref>

As a Republic player, the Knight is assumed to make only [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light-side]] decisions throughout the course of the game,<ref name="Light Side">[[Forum:CT:TOR and video game canon|Community consensus]] is to assume that the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] classes in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' choose the options that provide the most [[Light side of the Force/Legends|light side]] alignment points.</ref> although most details of the storyline are consistent across all alignment options. Regardless of player choice, Tarnis<ref name="Race to the Ruins" /> and Salarr will both die,<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" /> though both Vistis Garn and Nidaljo can be handled differently. Vistis Garn can be killed for dark side points,<ref name="Stolen Secrets" /> and Nidaljo can be forced to aid the player through a [[Mind trick/Legends|mind trick]], although this also results in dark side points.<ref name="Tracking Down the Traitor" />
